description: GOPEM is a graphical interface to the Open Source PEM Fuel Cell Simulation Tool, OPEM. It exposes fuel-cell model inputs and results through a desktop application while relying on the separate OPEM simulation package. Inputs are electrochemical and operating parameters for a proton-exchange membrane fuel cell; outputs are the underlying model's predicted performance and visualisations. The simulated device and run conditions are selected by the user, with no fixed geographic coverage. The GUI code is free under MIT terms, and its README provides source and portable-build options. A limitation is that older Windows systems may require a separately installed Visual C++ runtime, and the portable build starts more slowly. GOPEM is useful for component-level hydrogen and fuel-cell infrastructure analysis, not a gas-network simulator. It is related to OPEM as its frontend; the underlying solver was not executed here.
name: GOPEM fuel-cell simulator interface
